<!--
  One member of TeamGrid beside a small portrait: the name, the role, then the department and the place
  (detailed, directory), the bio (detailed) and the skills (detailed, list).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Member } from "../blocks/team-grid.types";

  export type MemberRowProps = {
    member: Member;
    depts: Record<string, string>;
    layout?: "cards" | "minimal" | "detailed" | "list" | "directory";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { at, cn } from "../utils";

  let { member, depts, layout = "list" }: MemberRowProps = $props();
</script>

<Group
  gap="4"
  align="start"
  class={
    (layout as string) === "detailed" ? "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex-col p-6"
    : (layout as string) === "directory" ? "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
    : "border-b border-border pb-4"
  }
  data-slot="item"
>
  <MediaFrame
    alt={member.name}
    ratio="1/1"
    class={cn((((layout as string) === "detailed") ? "size-16" : "size-12"), "shrink-0")}
  />
  <Stack gap="2" class="min-w-0 flex-1">
    <Stack gap="0">
      <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
        {member.name}
      </Text>
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {member.role}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
    {#if ((layout as string) !== "list")}
      <Group gap="2" align="center" class="flex-wrap text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <Badge variant="outline" size="sm">
          {at(depts, member.dept)}
        </Badge>
        <LucideIcon name="map-pin" size={16} />
        <Inline>
          {member.location}
        </Inline>
      </Group>
    {/if}
    {#if ((layout as string) === "detailed")}
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {member.bio}
      </Text>
    {/if}
    {#if ((layout as string) !== "directory")}
      <Group gap="2" class="flex-wrap">
        {#each member.skills as k (k)}
          <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm">
            {k}
          </Badge>
        {/each}
      </Group>
    {/if}
  </Stack>
</Group>
